podcast.body: This album is described as a brilliant pre-punk record, with its title track embodying the raw energy of Iggy and The Stooges. "Iggy and the Stooges from 1973 in the title track of a brilliant pre-punk album called Raw Power."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album was created with the patronage of David Bowie, who convinced his manager to invest cash into The Stooges project. The album was intentionally designed to be extremely intense, aiming to "actually hurt people as it came out of the speakers." It features the song "Search and Destroy." "The result was an injection of cash that was enough to make an album that was designed to be so intense that it would actually hurt people as it came out of the speakers."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
